h: VeryDarkMan reportedly praises Tinubu's political strategy and says rivals including Peter Obi lack his nerve
p: Social commentator VeryDarkMan has reportedly said President Tinubu's political approach is stronger than that of his rivals, naming Peter Obi among them. The remark is drawing mixed reactions from supporters of different camps ahead of 2027.
more: Supporters of the NDC and the APC are trading views on social media.
The 2027 race is already heating up online.
